blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR .
blocks.zh: 在复杂的包含的视觉推理情景中,代理人往往只有有限的视野,回答一个问题所需的证据可能分布在时间,观点和相互作用的对象之间. 因此,模型可能会给出一个可信的答案,而从未观察到支持模型的相关对象、时间或观点。 目前视觉推理基准主要评价被动观察和最终答案,俯瞰需要主动推理和取证的设置. 我们引入了JRDB-AVR,这是通过结构化的问题生成引擎从现有现实世界JRDB机器人数据中衍生出来的基准,将这一缺口转化为明确的评价:一个体现的代理系统收到一个视觉推理问题,请求通过时间戳和观看角度进行边界观测,并在最终答案和支持它的基础视觉证据上进行评价. 该基准包含涉及时间搜索、观点选择和以人为本的构成推理等多个现实世界环境中的各种问题。 我们还引入了JRDB-AVR-Agent,一种参考活性推理代理方法,它通过解析来保持一个明确的以观测为基础的图表为基础的世界模型和答案. 实验揭示了当前基线中答案准确度和证据准确度之间的巨大差距,表明当前VLM可以产生无根据的正确答案,积极的证据意识评价对于体现的视觉推理是必要的. 代码和基准见https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Embodied agents often need to answer questions in environments that they cannot fully observe at once. Since a robot camera has a limited field of view, the evidence needed for reasoning may lie in another direction or appear at another time. Consider a robot in a crowded cafe asked whether the person near the counter was carrying a bag before joining a group. The question cannot be reduced to simply recognizing an object in one image: the required evidence may appear in an earlier frame, a different viewing angle, or a particular person among several visually similar people. In this setting, answer correctness alone is an unsafe signal for visual reasoning capability. A system can guess the right answer from priors or partial context while grounding it in the wrong person, time, or view, which is exactly the hallucination an embodied agent must avoid.
blocks.zh: 健壮的特工往往需要在他们无法同时充分观察的环境中回答问题. 由于机器人相机的视野有限,推理所需的证据可能位于另一个方向或出现在另一个时间. 想想一个拥挤的咖啡馆里的机器人 问柜台附近的人在加入一个团体之前是否携带一个袋子. 这个问题不能简化为简单地在一个图像中识别一个物体:所需的证据可能出现在更早的帧中,不同的取景角度,或者在几个视觉相似的人中出现特定的人. 在此设定中,单答正确性是视觉推理能力的不安全信号. 一个系统可以从前言或部分语境中猜出正确的答案,同时将其建立在错误的人,时间或视图中,而这正是一个体现的代理人必须避免的幻觉.

blocks.en: These failure cases reveal a broader evaluation gap. In embodied visual reasoning, success depends not only on producing a correct answer, but on deciding where to look, when to look, and whether the acquired observation actually supports the answer. Existing video reasoning benchmarks evaluate passive-input capabilities ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ; Yi et al., 2019 ; Wu et al., 2021 ; Lei et al., 2018 ; Lei et al., 2020 ) , and embodied human-scene datasets such as JRDB-Reasoning provide rich reasoning annotations over real-world robotic scenes ( Jahangard et al., 2024 ; Jahangard et al., 2026 ) . However, these settings still largely evaluate reasoning with passive perception, and typically score the final answer rather than the supporting evidence. This setup can therefore overstate embodied visual reasoning ability, especially in complex real-world environments where an agent must resolve temporal ambiguity, choose the right viewpoint, and identify the correct person in a crowded scene.
blocks.zh: 这些失败案例揭示了更广泛的评价差距。 在体现的视觉推理中,成功不仅取决于产生一个正确的答案,还取决于决定在哪里看,何时看,以及获得的观察是否真正支持答案. 现有视频推理基准评价被动输入能力(Hudson and Manning,2019;Yi等人,2019;Wu等人,2021;Lei等人,2018;Lei等人,2020),以及包含的JRDB-Reasoning等人景数据集为真实世界机器人场景提供了丰富的推理说明(Jahangard等人,2024;Jahangard等人,2026). 然而,这些设置仍然在很大程度上以被动感知来评价推理,通常会给最终答案而不是辅助证据打分. 因此,这种设置可以过度描述包含的视觉推理能力,特别是在复杂的现实世界环境中,一个代理人必须解决时间模糊,选择正确的观点,并在拥挤的场景中识别正确的人.

blocks.en: This gap has become sharper as recent VLMs and tool-using agents produce increasingly accurate answers and multi-step trajectories ( Li et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2025b ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Surís et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024 ) . A correct answer or detailed reasoning trace is still not evidence that the agent inspected the right objects. Recent VLMs can answer plausibly from language priors, dataset bias, or partial visual context even when the relevant visual evidence is missing or incorrectly localized ( Gou et al., 2025 ) . If evaluation fixes the observation in advance or scores only the final answer, unsupported success remains hard to distinguish from grounded reasoning. For active embodied systems, this is part of the task definition instead of a minor interpretability issue.
blocks.zh: 随着近期的VLM和工具使用剂产生越来越准确的答案和多步轨迹,这一差距变得更加明显(Li等人,2023年;Zhu等人,2023年;Bai等人,2025年b;姚等人,2023年;Surís等人,2023年;Gao等人,2024年)。 正确的答案或详细的推理追踪仍然不能证明代理人检查了正确的物品。 近期的VLM可以从语言前传,数据集偏差,或部分视觉上下文中解答,即使相关视觉证据缺失或不正确本地化(Gou等人,2025年). 如果评价事先确定观察结果,或只给最后答案打分,那么没有支持的成功仍然很难与有根据的推理区分开来。 对于积极体现的系统来说,这是任务定义的一部分,而不是一个次要的解释性问题。

blocks.en: We therefore introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark for real-world embodied active visual reasoning derived from the existing JRDB dataset ( Martín-Martín et al., 2023 ) . Creating real active embodied reasoning data is difficult because a live robot cannot simultaneously observe every direction and every moment. JRDB-AVR addresses this by repurposing JRDB panoramic robot videos into an observation interface: an agent receives a visual reasoning question and can request observations by timestamp and viewing angle. Instead of curating static fixed-view VQA examples, we construct JRDB-AVR using a refined question-generation pipeline that derives active reasoning questions from JRDB annotations ( Jahangard et al., 2024 ; Jahangard et al., 2026 ; Ehsanpour et al., 2022 ; Le et al., 2024 ; Saadatnejad et al., 2023 ; Biswas et al., 2026 ; Vendrow et al., 2023 ) . JRDB-AVR formalizes active observation as the benchmark protocol, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded bounding box as visual evidence. The benchmark focuses on multi-step active visual reasoning over real-world crowded scenes, including temporal search, viewpoint selection, and compositional multi-object reasoning. Figure 1 illustrates this shift in evaluation: rather than judging a model only by whether it can produce a plausible answer from partial context, JRDB-AVR asks whether the agent actively acquires the right observation and grounds its answer in visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们采用了JRDB-AVR,这是现实世界的一个基准,它体现了从现有的JRDB数据集(Martín-Martín等人,2023年)中得出的积极视觉推理。 创建真实的活性内含的推理数据是困难的,因为活的机器人不能同时观察每一个方向和每一个时刻. JRDB-AVR通过将JRDB全景机器人视频重用到一个观测界面来解决这个问题:一个代理接收到一个视觉推理问题,可以通过时间戳和查看角度请求观察. 我们没有研究静态固定视图的VQA实例,而是使用精细的问题生成管道构建JRDB-AVR,该管道从JRDB说明(Jahangard等人,2024年;Jahangard等人,2026年;Ehsanpour等人,2022年;Le等人,2024年;Saadatnejad等人,2023年;Biswas等人,2026年;Vendrow等人,2023年)中得出积极推理问题。 JRDB-AVR正式将主动观测作为基准协议,并被作为视觉证据在最终答案和被定位的边框上评价. 该基准侧重于对现实世界拥挤场景的多步活动视觉推理,包括时间搜索,观点选择,以及组成式多对象推理. 图1说明了评价的这种转变:JRDB-AVR不只通过判断模型是否能够从部分上下文得出一个可信的答案来判断模型,而是询问代理人是否积极获得正确的观察结果,并以视觉证据作为其答案的依据。

blocks.en: To study how current VLM and agentic baselines perform under this benchmark, we introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent as a reference baseline for active reasoning on JRDB-AVR. JRDB-AVR-Agent converts each question into a structured graph plan, actively observes the scene, writes observation-grounded entities, attributes, and relations into an explicit world model, and answers by solving the resulting graph state. Current results show that answer performance and evidence performance can diverge substantially: models may obtain correct answers without providing correct visual support. Thus, answer-only evaluation obscures important embodied reasoning failures.
blocks.zh: 为了研究当前VLM和代理基线如何在这个基准下运行,我们引入JRDB-AVR-Agent作为JRDB-AVR主动推理的参考基线. JRDB-AVR-Agent将每个问题转换成结构化的图表计划,积极观察场景,将观察基实体,属性,关系写成明确的世界模型,通过解析产生的图表状态来解答. 目前的结果显示,答案性能和证据性能可能存在很大差异:模型可能获得正确的答案,而不提供正确的视觉支持. 因此,只回答评价掩盖了体现的重要推理失败。

blocks.en: The contributions of this paper are: 1. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark for real-world embodied active visual reasoning, together with a benchmark generation engine that derives active reasoning questions from JRDB annotations. We also define an evaluation protocol and metrics that report answer, evidence, and combined correctness, making the answer-evidence gap explicit when correct answers rely on unsupported visual evidence. 2. We provide JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning baseline that uses a structured graph plan, an observation-grounded world model, and a graph solving method to produce answer-evidence predictions. 3. We present an important empirical finding from the current evaluation protocol: strong baselines can reach materially different answer and evidence performance, showing that active visual reasoning needs evidence-aware evaluation rather than answer accuracy alone.
blocks.zh: 本文件的贡献是: 1. 我们介绍了JRDB-AVR,这是现实世界中包含主动视觉推理的基准,以及从JRDB说明中得出主动推理问题的基准生成引擎。 我们还界定了一种评价协议和衡量标准,用以报告答案、证据和综合正确性,在正确答案依赖不支持的视觉证据时,使答案-证据差距明确。 2. 我们提供了JRDB-AVR-Agent,一个参考活性推理基线,该基准使用结构化的图表计划,一个以观测为基础的世界模型,以及一个图表解析方法来产生答案-证据预测. 3. 我们从目前的评价协议中提出一个重要的经验结论:强有力的基线可以达到实质上不同的答案和证据性能,表明积极的视觉推理需要了解证据的评价,而不是仅仅回答准确性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Previous visual reasoning benchmarks have established protocols for testing compositional questions, temporal events, and evidence in fixed visual inputs ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . For example, GQA emphasizes compositional question answering over images ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) , CLEVRER tests causal and temporal reasoning in synthetic videos ( Yi et al., 2019 ) , STAR targets situated video question answering ( Wu et al., 2021 ) , MindCube studies spatial mental modeling from limited views ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and TVQA+ links questions to spatio-temporal evidence in video ( Lei et al., 2020 ) . Recent grounded video QA evaluation also asks whether a correct answer is visually supported by the relevant evidence ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Ke et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ) . Temporal grounding and spatio-temporal video understanding benchmarks further study when events occur and where relevant evidence lies across clips ( Shou et al., 2016 ; Buch et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . JRDB-based datasets bring this reasoning into crowded embodied scenes with social structure and robot-centric sensing ( Jahangard et al., 2024 ; Jahangard et al., 2026 ) . However, existing benchmarks generally evaluate either reasoning over fixed visual inputs or grounding within already provided videos. As summarized in Table 1 , JRDB-AVR changes the benchmark protocol: an agent must actively acquire observations in a real-world embodied environment, and the final prediction is evaluated by both answer correctness and whether the acquired evidence supports the answer.
blocks.zh: 以往的视觉推理基准为测试组成问题、时间事件和固定视觉输入中的证据建立了协议(Ma等人,2026年)。 例如,GQA强调在图像上解答组成问题(Hudson和Manning,2019年),CLEVRER测试合成视频中的因果关系和时间推理(Yi等人,2019年),STAR目标定位视频问题解答(Wu等人,2021年),MindCube从有限角度研究空间心理模型(Wang等人,2025年),TVQA+将问题链接到视频中的spatio-时空证据(Lei等人,2020年). 近期的基于视频QA评价也询问正确答案是否有相关证据的视觉支持(Xiao等人,2024年;Ma等人,2026年;Ke等人,2026年;Du等人,2026年). (Shou等人,2016年;Buch等人,2019年;Wang等人,2024年b;Yang等人,2025年) 基于JRDB的数据集将这种推理带入拥挤的包含着社会结构和以机器人为中心的感知的场景(Jahangard等人,2024年;Jahangard等人,2026年). 然而,现有基准一般要么评价固定视觉输入的推理,要么在已经提供的视频中定位。 如表1所概述,JRDB-AVR改变了基准协议:一个代理商必须在现实世界中包含的环境中积极获取观测结果,最终预测通过回答正确性以及获取的证据是否支持答案来评价.

blocks.en: A common starting point for visual reasoning ( Ke et al., 2025b ) is to use general-purpose VLMs as monolithic predictors over fixed image or video inputs ( Li et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Bai et al., 2025b ) . To improve interpretability and control, early compositional methods explicitly decomposed questions into modular networks or executable programs ( Johnson et al., 2017 ) . More recent compositional pipelines expose intermediate programs, localized zoom-and-refinement stages, grounded actions, or tool calls ( Tiong et al., 2022 ; Surís et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2023 ; Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ) . Agentic and tool-integrated methods then extend this pattern toward multi-step reasoning with iterative action or tool use, feedback, memory, or explicit state ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Gou et al., 2024 ; Ke et al., 2024 ; Ke et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2025b ; Cai et al., 2025c ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , with related work also studying LLM-symbolic planning and Bayesian, hierarchical, and active goal recognition under uncertainty ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . In parallel, neuro-symbolic and structured-world-model approaches use explicit intermediate representations of entities and relations to support multi-step reasoning ( Yi et al., 2018 ; Kamali et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ) . These advances help motivate active visual reasoning, but they are usually evaluated on passive visual inputs. In contrast, JRDB-AVR makes active evidence acquisition part of the benchmark requirement. To instantiate this protocol, we provide JRDB-AVR-Agent as a reference baseline with question-to-graph planning, observation-grounded world model maintenance, and graph solving.
blocks.zh: 视觉推理的一个常见起点(Ke等人,2025年b)是使用通用VLM作为固定图像或视频输入的单一预测器(Li等人,2023年;Zhu等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年a;Bai等人,2025年b). 为提高可解释性和控制性,早期的构成方法明确将问题分解为模块网络或可执行程序(Johnson等人,2017年). 较近期的构成管道暴露了中间方案、局部的放大和精炼阶段、有底的行动或工具呼叫(Tiong等人,2022年;Surís等人,2023年;Yu等人,2025年;Shen等人,2023年;Huang等人,2026年b;Lu等人,2023年;Gupta和Kembhavi,2023年)。 代理法和工具集成法将这一模式扩展为多步骤推理,并采用迭代动作或工具使用、反馈、记忆或明确状态(Gao等人,2023年;Gao等人,2024年;Gou等人,2024年;Ke等人,2025年a;Wu等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年;Cai等人,2025年b;Cai等人,2025年c;Ma等人,2024年;Chen等人,2026年),相关工作还研究LLM-symbolic 规划和Bayesian,层次和不确定情况下的积极目标识别(黄等人,2025年;张等人,2024年;张等人,2025年;张等人,2026年b;张等人,2026年a). 同时,神经元和结构化-世界模型方法使用实体和关系的明确中间表示支持多步骤推理(Yi等人,2018年;Kamari等人,2025年;Cai等人,2025年a;Huang等人,2026年a;Li等人,2026年). 这些进步有助于激发主动视觉推理,但通常通过被动视觉输入来评价. 相反,JRDB-AVR将主动取证作为基准要求的一部分。 为了即时化这个协议,我们提供了JRDB-AVR-Agent作为参考基线,其中包含问答式规划,观测定位的世界模型维护,以及图表解析.

blocks.en: 3 JRDB-AVR Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3个JRDB-AVR 基准

blocks.en: JRDB-AVR evaluates active visual reasoning in real-world embodied environments. Each task instance asks a system to answer a question while deciding which observations are needed, and then to return both the answer and its visual evidence. The benchmark is designed so that the correctness of the answer and of the evidence can diverge: a system may guess the right answer from priors or partial context, but still fail if the evidence person, frame, viewpoint, or box does not support that answer.
blocks.zh: JRDB-AVR评价现实世界内含环境中的主动视觉推理. 每个任务实例都提出一个系统来回答一个问题,同时决定需要哪些观察,然后返回答案及其视觉证据。 基准的设计是为了让答案和证据的正确性可以有差异:一个系统可能从先前或部分上下文中猜测正确的答案,但如果证据人,框架,观点或框不支持这个答案,则仍然失败.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集生成

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the data generation process from the raw source data to JRDB-AVR.
blocks.zh: 图2总结了从原始源数据到JRDB-AVR的数据生成过程.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Dataset generation pipeline for JRDB-AVR. Starting from JRDB panoramic videos and annotations, we organize object boxes, tracks, poses, relations, social groups, actions, etc into temporal scene graphs. Question generators search these scene graphs for active reasoning patterns and produce candidate questions, which are retained only after they pass evidence, necessity, uniqueness, and manual quality checks.
blocks.zh: 图 2:JRDB-AVR的数据集生成管道. 从JRDB全景视频和说明开始,我们将对象盒,音轨,姿势,关系,社会团体,动作等组织成时间场景图. 质询生成器搜索这些场景图表以获取主动推理模式,并产生候选质询,这些质询只有在通过证据,必要性,独特性和人工质量检查后才保留.

blocks.en: JRDB-AVR builds on the JRDB video dataset ( Martín-Martín et al., 2023 ) , which includes crowded indoor and outdoor environments, person tracks, actions, spatial relations, and social context annotations ( Vendrow et al., 2023 ; Ehsanpour et al., 2022 ; Le et al., 2024 ; Jahangard et al., 2024 ; Jahangard et al., 2026 ) . The benchmark is generated from complementary annotations provided by JRDB and its extension datasets. These include person identities, tracks, and bounding boxes from JRDB ( Martín-Martín et al., 2023 ) ; spatio-temporal actions from JRDB-Act ( Ehsanpour et al., 2022 ) ; human poses from JRDB-Pose; panoptic tracks from JRDB-PanoTrack ( Le et al., 2024 ) ; social-group and interaction annotations from JRDB-Social ( Jahangard et al., 2024 ) ; and human-object and geometric relations from JRDB-Reasoning ( Jahangard et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: JRDB-AVR基于JRDB的视频数据集(Martín-Martín等人,2023年),其中包括拥挤的室内和室外环境,人行道,动作,空间关系,以及社会背景说明(Vendrow等人,2023年;Ehsanpour等人,2022年;Le等人,2024年;Jahangard等人,2024年;Jahangard等人,2026年). 该基准来自JRDB提供的补充说明及其扩展数据集. 其中包括JRDB(Martín-Martín等人,2023年);JRDB-Act(Ehsanpour等人,2022年);JRDB-Pose的人体姿势;JRDB-PanoTrack(Le等人,2024年);JRDB-Social(Jahangard等人,2024年);以及JRDB-Reasoning(Jahangard等人,2026年)的人体物体和几何关系。

blocks.en: We first generate a scene graph from the JRDB annotations for each sequence (video in JRDB dataset) that supports controlled sub-graph search for question generation. This graph organizes tracked objects, relations, attributes, and timestamps together with the facts needed for question generation, including person attributes, actions over time, robot-relative geometry, person-to-person relations, person presence, and bounding boxes, from which viewpoint-specific evidence is derived. In this way, dataset generation becomes a subgraph-search process rather than free-form question generation.
blocks.zh: 我们首先从JRDB注释中为每个序列生成一个场景图(在JRDB数据集中的视频),支持受控子图搜索问题生成. 本图将跟踪对象,关系,属性,和时间戳与生成问题所需的事实,包括人物属性,随时间推移的行动,机器人相对几何,人与人的关系,人物存在,以及边框,从中得出特定观点的证据. 这样,数据集生成成为子图搜索过程,而不是自由形式问题生成.

blocks.en: We then generate question candidates by querying this scene graph for patterns that induce active reasoning. The proposed benchmark is built from seven VQA generators, summarized in Table 2 . These generators create the main forms of active evidence search discussed in this work: localizing action temporal segments, following multi-hop relational paths, searching across time for a later state, and recovering a target from a unique anchor across time. Each question candidate is generated together with the benchmark fields needed for later evaluation, including the bounding boxes of evidence objects. Please refer to supplementary material for more details regarding question generators.
blocks.zh: 然后我们通过查询这个场景图来生成问题候选者,以了解诱导主动推理的规律. 拟议基准由7台VQA发电机建立,汇总于表2。 这些生成器创建了本作品中讨论的主动证据搜索的主要形式:将动作时间段本地化,遵循多跳关系路径,跨时间搜索后期状态,以及从一个独特的锚地中从不同时间恢复一个目标. 每个问题候选人与以后评价所需的基准字段一起产生,包括装有证据的方块。 关于问题发生器的详情,请参考补充材料。

blocks.en: Table 2: For each of the seven generators currently present in JRDB-AVR, the table provides a brief description of the generator, its question type and the metrics protocol of each question type.
blocks.zh: 表2:关于JRDB-AVR目前存在的7台发电机中的每台,该表简要说明了发电机,其问号类型以及每个问号类型的计量协议.

blocks.en: Question candidates are not kept simply because a subgraph is matched. To ensure data quality, after generation, we automatically re-derive the stored answer from trusted JRDB annotations and retain only questions whose supporting evidence can be objectively recovered. This validation pass enforces evidence verifiability together with temporal necessity, multi-step necessity, view necessity, anchor uniqueness for unique-anchor rows, and hop necessity for chain questions. As a result, questions are removed when they remain answerable after perturbing the target time or collapsing an intermediate hop, as well as when their evidence cannot be evaluated reliably. Furthermore, the authors manually inspect a random subset of generated questions for verification.
blocks.zh: 提问候选人并非仅仅因为子图匹配而被保留. 为了确保数据质量,在生成后,我们自动从信任的JRDB注释中重新找到存储的答案,并只保留其支持证据可以客观回收的问题. 此验证证书可执行证据可核查性,同时执行时间必要性、多步骤必要性、视图必要性、锁定独特锁定行的独特性,以及对链条问题的跳动必要性。 因此,当问题在扰动目标时间或中途跳槽后仍能回答时,以及当其证据不能得到可靠评价时,就会被移除。 此外,作者手动检查了随机产生的问题,以供核查。

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集统计

blocks.en: JRDB-AVR is generated from the 27 JRDB test sequences using the corresponding JRDB and extension-dataset annotations. The released benchmark contains 2,098 active VQA questions. These counts describe the current released benchmark and should not be read as an upper bound on all valid questions derivable from the source annotations. The generation engine can be used to derive additional active visual reasoning questions from the same source data.
blocks.zh: JRDB-AVR是由使用相应的JRDB和扩展数据集说明的27个JRDB测试序列生成的. 发布的基准包含2,098个活跃的VQA问题. 这些计数描述了当前发布的基准,不应被理解为对源说明产生的所有有效问题的上限。 生成引擎可以用来从同一个源数据中得出额外的主动视觉推理问题.

blocks.en: 3.3 Benchmark Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 基准议定书

blocks.en: A task session contains a question q q and related metadata. The system receives q q and may request observations before producing a final answer. A completed prediction contains the answer y ^ \hat{y} in the required format together with evidence e ^ \hat{e} , represented as the target localization by timestamp and bounding box. The task is active because the system is not given one fixed complete view up front, and it must choose where and when to look before answering.

It returns a 480 × \times 480 RGB cropped frame with some metadata rendered from stitched raw RGB JRDB videos (3760 × \times 480, 15FPS). However, typically the agent does not receive the full panorama as the initial input. This choice keeps the benchmark close to embodied environments: the embodied agent system actively decides what to observe at a selected time and angle rather than reading the full scene at once.

blocks.en: 4 JRDB-AVR-Agent
blocks.zh: 4个JRDB-AVR-代理

blocks.en: JRDB-AVR-Agent is a training-free reference active reasoning baseline for JRDB-AVR. It instantiates the benchmark’s core challenge with an explicit world model: the agent must first observe the scene, write observation-grounded facts into a world model as memory, and then answer from the current world-model state. Because the relevant evidence may be scattered across time, viewpoint, and objects, a single observation or free-form reasoning trajectory is insufficient. The agent therefore maintains an explicit graph-based world model to accumulate observed entities, attributes, relations, viewpoints, and unresolved evidence across interaction steps. A graph plan state guides the future observation and supports the final answer-evidence prediction. Together, these components make JRDB-AVR-Agent an evidence-aware active reasoning reference baseline.
blocks.zh: JRDB-AVR-Agent是JRDB-AVR的无训练参考活性推理基线. 它用一个明确的世界模型来即兴地描述基准的核心挑战:代理商必须首先观察场景,将观察依据的事实写成一个世界模型作为记忆,然后从目前的世界模型状态来回答. 由于相关证据可能分散在时间、观点和物体之间,单一的观测或自由形式的推理轨迹是不够的。 因此,代理人维持一个以图表为基础的明确世界模型,以累积观察到的实体、属性、关系、观点和尚未解决的证据,跨越互动步骤。 一个图表计划状态可以指导未来的观测,并支持最后的答案-证据预测. 这些组件加在一起,使JRDB-AVR-Agent成为了证据意识的主动推理参考基准.

blocks.en: Given a question, the agent first constructs a structured graph plan that specifies what must be grounded before answering. The plan contains a root node, a target node, candidate nodes, directed edges, and an answer specification. This converts the question from an unconstrained natural-language prompt into a graph query over entities and relations: the root node defines the starting evidence anchor, the target node defines the entity or event to recover, the edges define the relational or temporal path to follow, and the answer specification defines how the final answer should be read from the grounded graph. The plan is schema-validated before interaction, so later observations and world model maintenance are organized around an explicit reasoning target rather than an unconstrained chain of thought.
blocks.zh: 在回答一个问题时,代理人首先会构建一个结构化的图表计划,规定在回答之前必须基于什么. 该计划包含一个根节点,一个目标节点,候选节点,定向边缘,以及一个答案规格. 这将问题从一个不受约束的自然语言提示转换成关于实体和关系的图表查询:根节点定义了起始证据锚,目标节点定义了要恢复的实体或事件,边缘定义了要遵循的关系或时间路径,答案规格定义了最终答案应该如何从被基于的图表中读取. 该计划在互动之前就经过了计划验证,所以后来的观测和世界模型维护都是围绕一个明确的推理目标,而不是一个不受约束的思想链来组织的.

blocks.en: The world model in JRDB-AVR-Agent is an explicit graph memory rather than a latent or purely textual state. At step t t , the world model W t W_{t} stores entities, attributes, relations, and observation provenance. Entity records represent grounded person or object hypotheses, attribute records store local visual facts such as appearance, action, or state, relation records store spatial, temporal, or person-to-person relations, and observation records link these graph facts to the frame and viewpoint from which they were obtained. This use follows memory and neuro-symbolic views of world models as structured environment representations ( Hao et al., 2023 ; Cai et al., 2025a ) , but it is not a predictive future-frame or video-generation model. Its purpose is to make the agent’s intermediate visual state readable, writable, and auditable.
blocks.zh: JRDB-AVR-Agent中的世界模型是明确的图记,而不是潜伏或纯粹的文字状态. 在step t t, 世界模型 W t W_{t} 存储实体,属性,关系,和观察来源. 实体记录代表被禁足的人或对象假说,属性记录存储了局部视觉事实,如外观,动作,或状态,关系记录存储空间,时间,或人与人的关系,观测记录将这些图表事实与获得这些事实的框架和观点联系起来. 这种使用遵循了对世界模型作为结构化环境代表的记忆和神经-连带观点(Hao等人,2023年;Cai等人,2025年a),但它不是一个预测未来框架或视频生成模型. 其目的是使代理商的中间视觉状态可读、可写和可审计。

blocks.en: The agent interacts with the benchmark through a set of tools. It may call get_graph to read the current world model state, observe to request a visual observation, add_entity to add a grounded entity, add_attribute to attach an observed property to an entity, add_relation to record a grounded relation, and final_answer to submit the final prediction. The observation action is observe(sequence, frame_index, angle_deg) , which returns a 480 × \times 480 crop with metadata. Importantly, the changes of the world model are observation-grounded: an entity, attribute, or relation can be added only when it is tied to an already obtained frame-view observation. This interaction design lets the agent decide at each step whether to request another observation, update grounded information into the world model, or stop and produce a final answer.
blocks.zh: 代理通过一组工具与基准相互作用. 它可以调用get_graph来读取当前的世界模型状态,观察来请求视觉观察,添加_实体来添加被禁实体,添加_属性来附加被禁实体的被禁属性,添加_关系来记录被禁关系,以及最终_答案来提交最终预测. 观测动作是观察(序列,帧_index,角度_deg),它返回一个有元数据的480×\times 480 裁剪. 重要的是,世界模型的改变是以观测为根据的:只有当一个实体、属性或关系与已经获得的帧视图观测联系起来时,才能添加。 这种交互设计让代理商在每一个步骤上决定是请求另一个观察,将基于基础的信息更新到世界模型中,还是停止并生成一个最终的答案.

During interaction, the agent selects tool actions from the current state, requests observations when needed, and writes observation-grounded entities, attributes, and relations into an explicit world model. The final answer is produced by solving the graph state and returning both the answer and supporting visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 图3:JRDB-AVR-Agent的管道. 这个问题首先转化为一个结构化的图表计划,其中明确了锚点,中间点和目标实体. 在互动过程中,代理从当前状态中选择工具动作,在需要时请求观察,并将基于观察的实体,属性和关系写入一个明确的世界模型. 最终的答案是通过解析图态并返回答案和辅助视觉证据生成的.

blocks.en: When final_answer is called, the agent does not simply accept a free-form answer. It first invokes a graph solver to solve the graph plan against the current world model. Concretely, the graph plan acts as a structured query, and the solver searches over graph facts accumulated from obtained observations to find a satisfying target. The proposed answer is then checked against this target, so that it is legal only if it is supported by the current graph state. The final output contains the predicted answer y ^ \hat{y} and the supporting evidence e ^ \hat{e} .
blocks.zh: 当最后的答案被调用时,代理不会简单地接受自由形式的答案. 它首先引用一个图表解析器来比照目前的世界模型解决图表计划. 具体地说,图图计划起到结构化查询的作用,解题者在图图上搜索从获得的观测中积累的事实,以找到一个令人满意的目标. 然后对照这一目标检查拟议答案,这样只有得到当前图表状态的支持,答案才是合法的。 最后输出包含预测的答案 y ^\ hat{y} 以及支持证据 e ^\ hat{e} 。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate on the released JRDB-AVR benchmark, which contains 2,098 active VQA questions from 27 JRDB test sequences. All methods are evaluated on the same question ids and under the same evaluation protocol introduced in Section 3 . We report three primary metrics: the answer score s ¯ ans \bar{s}_{\mathrm{ans}} , evidence score s ¯ evid \bar{s}_{\mathrm{evid}} , and combined score s ¯ comb \bar{s}_{\mathrm{comb}} defined in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们对发布的JRDB-AVR基准进行评估,该基准包含来自27个JRDB测试序列的2,098个活跃VQA问题. 所有方法都根据同一问题编号以及第3节中引入的同一评价规程进行评估。 我们报告三种主要衡量标准: 答案分数 s\bar{s}_{\ mathrm{ans} 证据分数 s evid {bar{s}_{\ mathrm{evid} 和 组合分数 s {bar{s}_{\ mathrm{comb} 定义于第3.3节。

blocks.en: We compare JRDB-AVR-Agent against the following four baseline methods which represent different levels of passive and active reasoning. Monolithic VLM answers from uniformly sampled panoramic context without active observation. Chain-of-Thought ( Wei et al., 2022 ) uses the same visual input but adds intermediate reasoning before producing the answer and evidence. Search-Recognize-Pipeline is a training-free localize-first workflow-based baseline inspired by zoom-and-refinement methods ( Yu et al., 2025 ) : it proposes a candidate target, requests an observation to refine the localization, and answers from the refined evidence. ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) uses a tool-use agentic loop with the observation tool. Since Monolithic VLM and Chain-of-Thought cannot actively call tools for active observation, we give them a sampled panoramic context as passive input. This lets them access a broader pre-selected visual context, but they cannot decide where/when to observe.
blocks.zh: 我们比较JRDB-AVR-Agent与以下四种代表不同程度被动和主动推理的基准方法。 单石VLM从统一抽样的全景上下文中解答,没有主动观测. 思考链(Wei等人,2022年)在生成答案和证据之前使用相同的视觉输入,但添加中间推理. Search-Recognizze-Pipeline是一款由缩放和精炼方法(Yu等人,2025年)启发的无培训本地化第一工作流程基线:它提出了候选目标,要求观察来细化本地化,并从精炼的证据中解答. ReAct(姚等人,2023年)与观测工具使用工具的代理环. 由于Monolithic VLM和Chain-of-Thought不能积极调用工具进行主动观测,所以我们给他们一个抽样全景背景作为被动输入. 这使得他们可以访问一个更广泛的预选视觉环境,但他们无法决定观察地点/时间。

blocks.en: All baseline methods are evaluated across six VLM backbones ( DeepMind, 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025a ; Team, 2026 ) : Gemma-4-E2B, Gemma-4-E4B, Qwen3-VL 4B, Qwen3-VL 8B, Qwen3.5 4B, and Qwen3.5 9B. All methods use the same benchmark questions, the same observe(sequence, frame_index, angle_deg) interface when observations are requested, and the same answer-evidence output schema. All methods are evaluated zero-shot on JRDB-AVR. JRDB-AVR-Agent is evaluated on the same benchmark using the active reasoning design described in Section 4 , including its explicit graph-based world model, and uses Qwen3.5 9B, which achieves the strongest baseline combined score under ReAct. All reported experiments were run on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 24GB GPU.
blocks.zh: 所有基准方法均通过六个VLM主干线(DeepMind,2026年;Bai等人,2025年a;Team,2026年)进行评估:Gemma-4-E2B,Gemma-4-E4B,Qune3-VL 4B,Qune3-VL 8B,Qune3.5 4B,以及Qune3.5 9B. 所有方法在请求观测时都使用相同的基准问题,相同的观察(序列,帧_index,角度_deg)接口,以及相同的答案-证据输出方案. 所有方法均在JRDB-AVR上评价为零射. JRDB-AVR-Agent使用第4节描述的主动推理设计,包括其明确的以图表为基础的世界模型,在同一基准上进行评估,并使用Quen3.5 9B,在ReAct下实现最强基线综合分数. 所有报告的实验都是在单一的NVIDIA RTX 4090 24GB GPU上进行的.

blocks.en: 5.1 Quantitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 5.1 定量比较

blocks.en: Table 3 reports results on the same benchmark. The main trend is that answer correctness and evidence grounding do not improve together. Across the baselines, the strongest answer, evidence, and combined results come from different model-method combinations: the best baseline answer score is 33.65, the best evidence score is 13.01, and the best combined score is 5.96. This shows that stronger answer prediction does not necessarily imply stronger evidence grounding.
blocks.zh: 表3报告的结果是同一基准。 主要趋势是,答案正确性和证据基础没有一起改善。 纵观基线,最强的答案,证据,综合结果来自不同的模型-方法组合:最佳基线答案分数为33.65分,最佳证据分数为13.01分,最佳综合分数为5.96分. 这表明,更强有力的答案预测并不一定意味着更强有力的证据基础。

blocks.en: JRDB-AVR-Agent achieves the best performance on answer, evidence, and combined correctness, reaching 38.51 answer, 27.50 evidence, and 14.54 combined score. Compared with the strongest baseline score for each metric, this corresponds to gains of 4.86 points in answer accuracy, 14.49 points in evidence accuracy, and 8.58 points in combined correctness. The substantially larger gains on evidence and combined correctness suggest that the explicit world model mainly helps the system ground its answers in observed visual support. This supports the central claim of JRDB-AVR: answer accuracy alone can hide cases where a model predicts a plausible answer but grounds it in the wrong person, timestamp, viewpoint, or box. The conditional Hallucination rate further clarifies this gap: the lowest baseline hallucination rate is 81.22, while JRDB-AVR-Agent lowers it to 62.25. Despite these improvements, the absolute combined score remains low, indicating substantial room for future progress in active evidence-grounded reasoning.
blocks.zh: JRDB-AVR-Agent在回答,证据,以及综合正确性方面都取得了最佳表现,达到38.51的回答,27.50的证据,14.54的综合分数. 与每个公尺最强的基准得分相比,这相当于回答准确度4.86分,证据准确度14.49分,综合正确度8.58分的得分. 在证据和综合正确性方面的显著提高表明,清晰的世界模式主要有助于系统将其答案建立在可见的视觉支持中。 这支持了JRDB-AVR的中心主张:单答精度可以隐藏一个模型预测一个可信答案但以错误的人、时间戳、观点或框为理由的案例。 有条件的幻觉率进一步明确了这一差距:基线幻觉率最低的是81.22,而JRDB-AVR-Agent将其降低到62.25. 尽管取得了这些改进,但绝对综合得分仍然很低,表明在积极循证推理方面今后有很大的进展余地。

blocks.en: The answer-evidence gap is the key empirical signal exposed by JRDB-AVR. VLM baselines can achieve moderate answer accuracy while providing much weaker target-grounding evidence: the strongest baseline answer score reaches 33.65, while the strongest baseline evidence score is 13.01 and the strongest combined score is only 5.96. This shows that many answer-correct predictions are not supported by correct visual evidence. JRDB-AVR-Agent reduces this gap by maintaining an observation-grounded world model as memory, improving evidence to 27.50 and combined correctness to 14.54. However, its answer score remains higher than its evidence score, indicating that active evidence grounding is still challenging even with an explicit world model.
blocks.zh: 答案-证据差距是JRDB-AVR暴露的关键经验信号. VLM基线可以实现中度解答精度,同时提供更弱的目标定点证据:最强基线解答分数达到33.65分,而最强基线证据分数为13.01分,最强综合分数仅为5.96分. 这表明许多回答正确的预测没有正确的视觉证据的支持. JRDB-AVR-Agent通过保持一个观测基的世界模型作为内存,将证据改进为27.50,合并的正确性降低到14.54. 然而,它的答案分数仍然高于其证据分数,表明即使有一个明确的世界模式,积极的证据基础仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that backbone choice affects performance, but does not by itself solve evidence grounding. Across VLM baselines, answer scores differ only moderately, while evidence and combined scores remain substantially lower. Different model-method combinations perform best on different metrics: Qwen3-VL 8B with ReAct gives the best answer score of 33.65, Qwen3-VL 4B with ReAct gives the best evidence score of 13.01, and Qwen3.5 9B with ReAct gives the best combined score of 5.96. The lowest baseline hallucination rate, 81.22, is obtained by Qwen3.5 9B with Search-Recognize-Pipeline. This variation across metrics further shows that stronger VLM backbones alone are insufficient for reliable evidence grounding. JRDB-AVR itself is method-agnostic and does not assume a VLM-based solution.
blocks.zh: 表3显示,骨干选择影响业绩,但本身并不解决证据依据问题。 在整个VLM基线中,答案的分数差别不大,而证据和合并的分数仍然低得多。 不同的模型-方法组合在不同的度量衡上表现最好:使用ReAct的Qune3-VL 8B给出了33.65的最好答案分,使用ReAct的Qune3-VL 4B给出了13.01的最好证据分,使用ReAct的Qune3.5 9B给出了5.96的最好综合分. 最低基线幻觉率81.22由Quen3.5 9B与Search-Recognizze-Pipeline获得. 各种衡量标准之间的这种差异进一步表明,单靠更强大的甚高频主干线不足以提供可靠的证据。 JRDB-AVR本身是方法不可知的,不假设基于VLM的解决方案.

blocks.en: Table 4 studies two high-level components of JRDB-AVR-Agent. Active Observation denotes active test-time use of the observe(sequence, frame_index, angle_deg) interface. World Model denotes the explicit observation-grounded world model used by JRDB-AVR-Agent, including graph planning, entities, attributes, and relations. The full agent uses both components. The non-active variant keeps the world model but replaces active observation with a predefined passive observation, and the no-world-model variant keeps active observation but removes the persistent graph planning and world model. The ablation results show that both components improve evidence-grounded reasoning: the world model increases evidence and combined scores, while active observation further improves grounded support. Both components also reduce the conditional hallucination rate, indicating that correct answers are more often supported by valid evidence in the full agent.
blocks.zh: 表4研究JRDB-AVR-Agent的两个高级组件. 主动观测(Active Observatory)表示对观测器(序列,帧_index,角度_deg)接口的主动测试时间使用. 世界模型表示JRDB-AVR-Agent使用的明确的观测基世界模型,包括图表规划,实体,属性,和关系. 全剂使用两种成分. 非活性变体保留了世界模型,但以预先定义的被动观测取代主动观测,无世界模型变体保留了主动观测,但删除了持续的图规划和世界模型. 衰减结果表明,这两个部分都改进了有证据依据的推理:世界模型增加了证据和综合分数,而积极观察则进一步提高了有依据的支持. 这两个构件还降低了有条件的幻觉率,表明正确答案在全剂中更常得到有效证据的支持.

blocks.en: The remaining errors highlight the challenge posed by JRDB-AVR. Even with an explicit world model, active visual reasoning still requires precise evidence binding across people, frames, viewpoints, and temporal segments. Questions are challenging because they require both selecting the right observations and grounding the final answer in the correct visual support. The results show that JRDB-AVR remains a challenging testbed for future work on active visual reasoning.
blocks.zh: 其余的错误突出了JRDB-AVR提出的挑战. 即使有一个明确的世界模型,积极的视觉推理仍需要精确的证据在人、框架、观点和时间段之间具有约束力。 问题具有挑战性,因为它们既需要选择正确的观察,也需要将最后的答案建立在正确的视觉支持上. 结果显示,JRDB-AVR仍然是未来主动视觉推理工作的一个挑战性测试平台.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: JRDB-AVR introduces a benchmark for active visual reasoning in real-world embodied environments, where systems must decide what to observe and support their answers with visual evidence. By reporting answer, evidence, combined correctness, and conditional hallucination, JRDB-AVR exposes unsupported answers that answer-only evaluation would hide. Our results show that JRDB-AVR-Agent, a world model active reasoning baseline, improves evidence grounding over VLM baselines, while the remaining gap highlights the difficulty of active observation and evidence grounding.
blocks.zh: JRDB-AVR引入了在现实世界所包含环境中主动视觉推理的基准,其中系统必须决定观察什么,并以视觉证据支持他们的答案. JRDB-AVR通过报告答案,证据,综合正确性,以及有条件的幻觉,暴露出不支持的答案,只回答评价就会隐藏. 我们的结果表明,JRDB-AVR-Agent是世界模型的主动推理基线,它改进了对VLM基线的证据基础,而剩下的空白则突出了积极观察和证据基础的困难。

blocks.en: Limitation. JRDB-AVR evaluates active reasoning over recorded observations rather than live robot control.
blocks.zh: 限制。 JRDB-AVR评价主动推理相对于记录的观测,而不是活的机器人控制.

blocks.en: Broader Impact. We hope JRDB-AVR supports future research on embodied active visual reasoning by encouraging methods to ground answers in visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 更宽的影响。 我们希望JRDB-AVR通过鼓励在视觉证据中提出答案的方法,支持未来对体现的主动视觉推理的研究.

blocks.en: Appendix A Question Candidate Generator Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 问题候选发电机详情

blocks.en: The seven VQA generators in JRDB-AVR are built from per-sequence scene graphs rather than free-form text generation. Each generated question is paired with the answer format required for evaluation, timestamp metadata, and verifiable target grounding whenever grounding is applicable. Multiple-choice questions use a strict 1-based choice index, while other questions use frame identification, temporal localization, frame-viewpoint pair, or numeric-value outputs. After generation, each candidate is re-validated against the source JRDB annotations, and only questions with recoverable evidence and a well-defined answer format are kept.
blocks.zh: JRDB-AVR中的7台VQA发电机由每序列场景图而不是自由形式文本生成而来. 每个产生的问题都与评价所需的答案格式、时间戳元数据以及可核查的目标在适用情况下的地面定位结合起来。 多选题使用严格的1基选择指数,而其他问题则使用帧识别,时间定位,帧视图点对,或数字值输出. 生成后,每个候选人都会根据来源JRDB说明重新验证,只保留有可收回证据和定义明确的答案格式的问题.

blocks.en: This family has two evaluated templates. The first asks for the frame at which a target action starts, and the second asks for the full start–end span of that action. Kept questions require stable action segments from the source annotations and reject nearby short breaks, so the benchmark does not reward trivial boundary guesses from noisy or short-lived state changes.
blocks.zh: 这个家族有两个被评价的模板. 第一个是要求启动目标行动的框架,第二个是要求这一行动的全部开始-结束阶段。 将问题从源代码说明中固定的动作段,并拒绝附近的短间隔,因此基准不会奖励来自吵闹或短寿命状态变化的细小边界猜测.

blocks.en: Chain 2-hop, Chain 3-hop, and Chain fork-join all use multiple-choice action answers, but each requires a distinct relational structure to be grounded before answering. These generators require a unique demographic or relational anchor, a unique annotation-supported path through intermediate people, and non-redundant hops. Thus, the answer must depend on following the intended path rather than shortcutting directly from the anchor to the final target.
blocks.zh: 链2-hop,链3-hop,和链叉-join都使用多选择动作解答,但每个解答都需要一个独特的关系结构在解答前被禁足. 这些发电机需要独特的人口或关系锚,通过中间人获得独特的注释支持的路径,以及非冗余跳动. 因此,答案必须取决于所要走的道路,而不是直接从锚到最终目标。

blocks.en: Chain hybrid combines spatial chaining with temporal and viewpoint search. The benchmark first uses a 2-hop path to identify the correct person, then searches over time for the first frame satisfying the queried action condition, and finally requires the viewpoint that best exposes the target. This is the only generator family evaluated with a frame-viewpoint pair answer mode, and all selected Chain hybrid questions are viewpoint-sensitive.
blocks.zh: 链杂交结合了空间链与时间和视角搜索. 基准首先使用2跳路径识别正确的人,然后随时间推移搜索满足被询问动作条件的第一个帧,最后需要最能曝光目标的观点. 这是唯一一个使用帧-视图点对答模式评价的生成器家族,所有选定的链式杂交题都是对视角敏感的.

blocks.en: Unique-anchor questions first identify a target from an anchor that remains unique under the available evidence, then ask about the same person’s action change, presence, or distance at a later point. Long-range questions instead emphasize temporally distant dependencies, with separate templates for action consequence, chain-style delayed reasoning, and numeric gap prediction.
blocks.zh: 唯一锁定者的问题首先从锚上识别出一个在已有证据下仍然独一无二的目标,然后询问同一人的动作变化、存在或稍后的距离。 长距离问题反而强调时间上遥远的依赖性,有单独的动作后果模板,链式延迟推理,以及数字差距预测.

blocks.en: Appendix C Baseline Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 细节

blocks.en: The reported benchmark compares four baseline methods together with JRDB-AVR-Agent: Monolithic VLM, Chain-of-Thought, Search-Recognize-Pipeline, and ReAct. All methods are evaluated on the same 2,098 benchmark questions and share the same answer-evidence scoring protocol. Across baselines, the paper reports six VLM backbones: Gemma-4 E2B (5B), Gemma-4 E4B (8B), Qwen3-VL 4B, Qwen3-VL 8B, Qwen3.5 4B, and Qwen3.5 9B. Monolithic VLM and Chain-of-Thought are fixed-context baselines because they do not expose an action interface, so they receive sampled panorama frames as passive visual input. Search-Recognize-Pipeline and ReAct use the public observation interface, with Search-Recognize-Pipeline making one proposal-driven observation and ReAct using an iterative tool-use loop. The following subsections summarize the execution order and main prompt templates used by each baseline.
blocks.zh: 所报告的基准与JRDB-AVR-Agent比较了四种基准方法:单体VLM、串式思维、搜索识别-Pipeline和ReAct。 所有方法都在同一2,098个基准问题上进行评估,并共享相同的答案-证据评分协议. 纵观基线,本文报告六个VLM主干线:Gemma-4 E2B(5B),Gemma-4 E4B(8B),Qune3-VL 4B,Qune3-VL 8B,Qune3.5 4B,以及Qune3.5 9B. Monolithic VLM和Chain-of-Thought是固定的文本基线,因为它们不暴露一个动作界面,因此它们作为被动的视觉输入接受抽样全景框架. Search-Recognizze-Pipeline和ReAct使用公共观测接口,Search-Recognizze-Pipeline制作一个提案驱动的观测,ReAct使用迭代工具使用循环. 以下各小节概述了每个基准所使用的执行命令和主要即时模板.

blocks.en: All completed predictions store the routed answer payload together with target-grounding evidence. The routed answer depends on the answer mode of the question: multiple-choice questions return a 1-based choice index, frame-identification questions return a frame id, temporal-localization questions return start and end frame ids, frame-viewpoint-pair questions return a frame id and viewpoint angle, and numeric-value questions return a numeric string. Evidence is scored through the target-grounding output under the evaluation protocol in Section 3.3 , rather than through free-form explanation text.
blocks.zh: 所有已完成的预测都储存了路由解答有效载荷以及确定目标的证据。 路由解答取决于问题的答案模式:多选择解答返回一个基于1的选择索引,帧识别解答返回一个帧id,时间定位解答返回和结束帧id,帧-视图解答返回一个帧id和视角角度,数字值解答返回一个数字字符串. 证据是通过第3.3节评价协议下的目标定位产出而不是通过自由形式解释文本获得的。

blocks.en: C.1 Monolithic VLM
blocks.zh: C.1 单体VLM

blocks.en: The monolithic baseline is a fixed-context single-pass method. It first samples a set of panorama frames and renders them as the only visual context. For each VQA question, it then issues one structured generation step that asks the model to emit the routed answer and exactly one target-person evidence box in the same JSON object. Thus the entire baseline is one fixed-input pass over sampled panorama context, with no active observation or intermediate reasoning stage.
blocks.zh: 单文基准是一种固定的文本单行道方法. 它首先对一组全景框架进行取样,并使其成为唯一的视觉上下文. 对于每个VQA问题,它随后会发布一个结构化的生成步骤,要求模型发出路由解答,并在同一JSON对象中准确发出一个目标人物证据盒. 因此,整个基线是一个固定投入流过抽样全景背景,没有主动观测或中间推理阶段。

blocks.en: The prompt is summarized by its role, visible inputs, and required output before giving the template.
blocks.zh: 该提示按其作用、可见的投入和提供模板前所需的产出加以归纳。

Frame IDs must be chosen only from the runtime-visible panorama frames listed below. Bboxes must use normalized current-view xyxy coordinates with each integer in [0,1000] . Do not include markdown, prose, wrapper tags, track_id , or extra keys. Question: <question> Choices: 1. <choice 1> 2. <choice 2> … Runtime-visible panorama frames: <frame_1, ..., frame_n> Ground the target person mentally before answering, then emit the answer and the supporting bbox in the same JSON object. Return the JSON result now.

blocks.en: For non-multiple-choice VQA questions, the same prompt body swaps in the answer-mode-specific schema lines. For example, a frame answer uses a JSON shape of the form {"answer":{"frame_id":"<supported_frame_id>"}, ...} , while temporal localization uses start_frame and end_frame keys.
blocks.zh: 对于非多重选择的VQA问题,在解答-mode特定方案线中相同的快速体交换. 例如,一个帧答案使用表单的JSON形状{"答案":{"帧_id":"<支持的_帧_id>}}, ...}),而时间定位则使用起始框和结尾框键.

blocks.en: C.2 Chain-of-Thought
blocks.zh: C.2 思想链

blocks.en: The Chain-of-Thought baseline reuses the same sampled panorama frames as Monolithic VLM, but inserts an explicit reasoning stage before the final answer-evidence stage. It first asks the model for a short structured reasoning list over the sampled panorama images, and then feeds that reasoning summary into a final answer-plus-bbox stage. The method therefore adds one intermediate reasoning step while remaining a fixed-context baseline with no active observation.
blocks.zh: 思维链基线再利用与Monolithic VLM相同的抽样全景框架,但在最后的答案-证据阶段之前插入一个明确的推理阶段. 它首先询问模型在抽样的全景图像之上的短结构推理列表,然后将推理摘要输入一个最后的答案+bbox阶段. 因此,该方法增加了一个中间推理步骤,同时保持固定的文字基线,没有主动观测。

blocks.en: The reasoning stage produces a concise structured summary from the sampled panorama context.
blocks.zh: 推理阶段从抽样的全景背景中产生一个简洁的结构化摘要.

When a reasoning step mentions a frame_id , use only a runtime-visible panorama frame listed below. Question: <question> Choices: 1. <choice 1> 2. <choice 2> … Runtime-visible panorama frames: <frame_1, ..., frame_n> Return the JSON result now.

blocks.zh: 经过推理后,最后阶段的提示要求模型以推理摘要为条件,生成路由解答和佐证证据.

blocks.en: The completed prediction follows the shared answer-evidence contract, while the reasoning summary serves only as an intermediate conditioning artifact for the final stage.
blocks.zh: 完成的预测遵循了共享的答案-证据合同,而推理摘要只是作为最终阶段的中间调节文物.

blocks.en: C.3 Search-Recognize-Pipeline
blocks.zh: C.3 搜索-识别-管道

blocks.en: The Search-Recognize-Pipeline baseline uses three model-generation stages with observation calls. It firstly observes a set of unified sampled frames and predicts one coarse target bbox from that panorama context. The coarse proposal is then converted into one observation through the benchmark observation interface. Given the returned observation view and the original question payload, the model predicts one crop-local refinement bbox. Finally, the model receives the selected refined crop observation, and the question payload, and produces the final answer with the localized target. Thus the execution order is search proposal → \rightarrow one observation → \rightarrow grounding refinement → \rightarrow final answer.
blocks.zh: 搜索-识别-Pipeline基线采用三个模型生成阶段,并有观测呼叫. 它首先观察了一组统一的抽样框架,并且从全景背景中预测出一个粗细的目标bbox. 然后通过基准观测接口将粗体建议转换为一项观测。 鉴于返回的观测视图和最初的问题有效载荷,该模型预测有一个作物局部精细化的box。 最后,该模型接收了选定的精制作物观测结果和问题有效载荷,并与局部目标产生最后答案。 因此,执行命令是搜索建议 \ 右侧一个观察 \ 右侧地面 改进 \ 右侧最后答案。

blocks.en: The first stage predicts a coarse target-person proposal from the initial visual input.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段从最初的视觉输入中预测粗糙的目标人物建议.

Return exactly one JSON object with the shape {"evidence_bboxes": [{"frame_id": "<frame>", "bbox": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}]} . blocks.zh: 第二阶段在返回的作物观测中完善了提案。

blocks.en: C.4 ReAct
blocks.zh: C.4 重新行动

blocks.en: The ReAct baseline begins from the question only, without pre-sampled panorama frames or crop observations, and repeatedly alternates between tool-use decisions and public observation calls. It initializes an empty observation list, an empty step history, an observation budget, and the legal set of observable frame ids. At every iteration, it predicts exactly one action JSON object. If the model returns observe , the method issues the public observation call and appends the resulting crop plus metadata to the history. If the model returns answer , the loop terminates and the baseline emits the final answer together with one evidence bbox on the most recent observation image. Thus, unlike the fixed-context baselines and the one-shot Search-Recognize-Pipeline workflow, ReAct exposes an iterative tool-use loop.
blocks.zh: ReAct基线只从问题开始,没有预先取样的全景框架或作物观测,在工具使用决定和公众观察呼叫之间反复替代. 它初始化了一个空的观测列表,一个空的步历史,一个观测预算,以及一组可观测的帧ID. 在每次迭代中,它都预测一个动作JSON对象. 如果模型返回观察,该方法会发布公共观测呼叫,并将由此产生的作物加元数据附加到历史中. 如果模型返回答案 , 循环终止, 基线会发出最后的答案, 并在最新的观测图像上发出一个证据 bbox。 因此,与固定的文本基线和一发搜索-识别-皮佩琳工作流程不同,ReAct暴露了一个迭代工具使用循环.

blocks.en: The recurrent action prompt receives the current observation history, step history, budget state, legal frame ids, and question payload, and returns exactly one JSON action.
blocks.zh: 经常性行动得到当前观测历史、步骤历史、预算状况、法律框架标识和质疑有效载荷,并返回一次JSON行动。

blocks.en: Prompt C.7: ReAct action stage You are an active visual reasoning ReAct agent. Return exactly one JSON object. Observe action schema: {"action": "observe", "frame_id": "<supported_frame_id>", "angle_deg": 180.0} . Tool calls used: <n> Budget limit: <B> Prior observations JSON: [...] Prior steps JSON: [...] Observed frame_id s so far: <...> Remaining non-duplicate observe budget before answering: <...> Choose the next observe action only from the legal frame_id s for this sequence and split. Use observe to reduce uncertainty before answering. If remaining budget is 0, you must return an answer action now. Question answer_mode : <answer_mode> Question: <question> Choices: 1. <choice 1> 2. <choice 2> … Answer action schema: {"action": "answer", "answer": 1, "evidence_bboxes": [{"frame_id": "<evidence_frame>", "bbox": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}]} . Any answer bbox must use normalized current-view xyxy coordinates with each integer in [0,1000] , relative to the most recent observation image only. If no observations exist yet, the next action must be observe . Return the JSON action now.

blocks.en: For non-multiple-choice VQA questions, the answer action schema line is replaced with the corresponding structured frame, span, frame-viewpoint, or numeric JSON schema. The prompt also contains answer-mode-specific strategy lines. For example, temporal-localization questions add an instruction that both start_frame and end_frame must be grounded before answering.
blocks.zh: 对于非多重选择的VQA问题,答案动作计划线替换为相应的结构框架,跨度,帧视图点,或数字JSON schema. 提示中还包含了针对答码的策略线. 例如,时间定位问题增加了一个指示,即启动-框架和结束-框架都必须在回答之前有依据。
